notes.title: Season 4 Update!
notes.content:
Heya everyone!

Season 4 has dropped, and with it comes a ton of updates, features, and new content! Jump in now and join the Discord to join tournaments that will be hosted in the following weeks!

MAP
Added new POIs: Riviera, Birchhaven, and Fort Regal, all major POIs located in the central-eastern areas of the map. Most of last seasons POIs are still in the game.

WEAPONS
Added new weapons: 2-Shot AR, Anarchy Auto Shotgun, 9mm Pistol, Micro SMG, and the Crossbow
Removed the following weapons: Armor Pistol, Revolver, Burst AR, TwinAuto Shotgun, and the Covert Ops AR

Added a new weapon rarity category: CONTRABAND
Contraband weapons can be obtained through vaults, located at the following POIs: Lindenburg, Fort Regal, and Birchhaven. These weapons are one of a kind and have ridiculously buffed stats, such as more rounds in the magazine or more damage.

VAULTS
The following Contraband weapons have been added to vaults:
Contraband 3-Shot AR
Contraband Anarchy Shotgun
Contraband Crossbow

SPIRE SHIELDS
What are spire shields?! Well... they are special shields found in rare rarity that grant special abilities depending on what shield you are carrying. Like the Ghost Shield, which, not only can deflect shots from opponents, but can also turn you almost invisible! Or the Gravity Shield, which adds a 5x jump multiplier as well as being able to deflect shots. Then there is the Dash Shield which gives the dash effect and also the Regen Shield, which can regenerate your health gradually when damaged. They are found in Vaults and Crates all around the map. Be on the lookout! There are 4 different Spire Shields to acquire.

SKINS
Added 3 new skins to the game and returned one: Mr. Chien (returned), Pete, Elfen, and Goat (all new).

LOBBY
You can now join parties or invite players to your party in Frontier! More on that in a future post.

PATCHES
Various bugs and fixes

Thanks to everyone for playing Frontier! Bugs will be patched over the weekend.

notes.title: Patch 3.7.0 for Frontier
notes.content:
3.7.0 has arrived... and with it comes new achievements, bug fixes, and overall optimizations to the game. Note: This is the LAST update branch of Season Three, as Season Four will be teased in a couple of days and will release fully in a couple of weeks, near the start of April,

WEAPONS
 - Buffed the Lightweight AR's damage by 1 for each rarity
 - Fixed a bug where the scope would stay visible on the screen after a player would switch a weapon
 - Fixed various shooting and weapon handling glitches and bugs

STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS 
 - Added new Steam Achievements to unlock: Looter, Rare Looter, Big Shot, No Scope, Forest Map, Swamp Map, and Sharpshooter
 - Removed the following Steam Achievements: Spooked!, Subzero, Polara, and Join Game

After many complaints and comments about the idea behind Season Achievements in Frontier, we decided to FULLY remove any seasonal achievements permanently. The main reason was that newer players could never unlock ALL of the Frontier achievements if they wanted to, since seasonal achievements could only be obtained if you played during a certain season and time-period. This is unfair, so starting from this update, Frontier will NO LONGER feature Seasonal Achievements and never will, so that all players, whether OGs or newcomers, will have the ability to 100% unlock all of the Frontier Steam achievements.

Thanks for supporting Frontier! Join the Discord to join tournaments, chat with the dev and have access to the latest seasonal news and updates!

APOKALYPTIK
4/25

notes.title: Update 3.5 for Frontier
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Update 3.5 is live. Patch Notes:

WORLD
 - Added a new POI: Waterfront
   Waterfront is a far corner POI located to the east of Shipyard and to the north-west of Hanamura, 
   where Mount Hana was previously located. It features an aircraft hangar built with the assets of 
   Shipment Station, but larger and has an actual aircraft inside. To the north of it, there is a new  
   dam that blocks the water flow. To the south of Shipyard, a new dock emerges, replacing the Kali-Jun 
   style landmark that was located there before. The whole area is scattered with crates, weapon spawns,
   weapon shelves, and mod stations, making it a great drop for vast loot.

 - Reworked Spawn Island
   Added a small shipyard to Spawn Island, along with new trees and some metal houses

GAME MODES
 - Added a new game mode: Comp
   Comp (Competitive, or tournaments for short) is a new game mode being tested for the Frontier Trial    
   Cup happening next Friday (March 7, more info on the Frontier Discord). It features a new leaderboard 
   system within it that calculates players score at the end of the game, where players can see in real-time
   what placements they have. It is still in early Beta and is bound to be buggy, hence why it is only for 
   admins and is under a password, which you must enter in order to host.

TOURNAMENTS
 - Like I said in the new Comp Game Mode section, there will be a Trial tournament next Friday (March 7) 
   at 5PM EST. The prize pool for this tournament is 300 Steam Points, which will only be given to the 
   winner of the Trial Cup. More info on the Frontier Discord

WEAPONS
 - Buffed the Pump Shotgun by 1 damage per pellet (8 overall) for each rarity except Rare (the blue one)

MISC
 - Reduced Game File Size from 4.4 GB to 4.0 GB

notes.title: Patch 3.3.0 for Frontier
notes.content:
Hey everyone, another update to the game.

WEAPONS
 - Introduced damage dropoff for hitscan weapons
 - Removed weapon rarity from names of weapons. Before: Basic Pump Shotgun. Now: Pump Shotgun (still basic rarity, just its removed from the name)
 - Reduced the size of the weapon of the TwinAuto Shotgun as it was too large 
 - Increased TwinAuto magazine size from 8 to 10
 - Increased TwinAuto damage by 1 per pellet (8 total) for each rarity except the Ultra version
 - TwinAuto now reloads 2 shells at a time instead oi 1, shortening the long reload time
 - Nerfed TwinAuto fire rate from 0.3 to 0.33 seconds between shots

GAME
 - Fixed leave game button not working 
 - Fixed not being able to host or join a game after leaving a match
 - Added a new inventory UI to the game. You can now swap items in your inventory and drop weapons; the inventory screen can be shown by pressing [I] on your keyboard
 - Made an overall graphics section in the settings menu so you can quick select which graphical preset you want with one click

FUTURE UPDATES/KNOWN ISSUES
 - Known Issue: Players cant host or join games after they have been disconnected from the server, for whatever reason
 - Known Issue: Various Inventory visual bugs on clients (not servers)

 - MAYBE adding DLCs soon. You will be able to purchase a DLC for around $5 and get all the heroes. Heroes dont give you any advantage when it comes to gameplay, and are purely visual, but the purchase made for the DLC will help fund the game with new assets and new seasons in the future. Even if you choose to keep the free version, you will still have 6 heroes you can play as and you can still play with someone who has the DLC or not. Once again, Frontier is NEVER going to be pay-to-win, and all skins are PURELY for cosmetic purposes ONLY.


 - Deyn V

GAME

UI

notes.title: Patch 3.0.1 for Frontier
notes.content:
Hey yall

Small update to hopefully fix some bugs and balance things out with the new Season 3 update

GAME
 - Added a mandatory training intro when launching Frontier for the first account (get the Complete Training achievement, the intro should last 2-4 minutes)

GAMEPLAY
 - (Hopefully) Fixed Mod Stations not spawning attachments on clients in some cases

BOTS
 - Added sliding to the array of bot movements

WEAPONS

[i]Over the last couple days, players reported that it was too easy to die quickly to weapons, so all but 4 weapons get a substantial nerf to balance the loot pool and make killing more strategic and rewarding[/i]

 - Nerfed the following weapons: Burst SMG (reduced damage by 3), Deadeye DMR (reduced damage by 8), Eagle-Eye Sniper Rifle (reduced damage by 8), Armor Pistol (reduced damage by 2), Pump Shotgun (reduced damage by 16), Guardian DMR (reduced damage by 5), Recon SMG (reduced damage by 1), Ambush AR (reduced damage by 2), Burst AR (reduced damage by 4)

- Buffed the following items: Jetpack (increase fly speed by 30%, increase vertical fly speed by 50%, increase fuel capacity by 30%), Dashpack (increased dash distance by 10%, increased dash charges capacity by 50%)

NEXT UPDATE: I am working on migrating Frontier to a source version of Unreal Engine, so I can make dedicate servers.

KNOWN ISSUES: Bots, in some cases, get stuck close to a mountain or hill and cant move. Hopefully this will be minimized with the sliding update to Bots and the refresh of the FrontierNavigationQuery.

Settings do save, but in some cases the sliders that control the graphics in the Settings menu appear to show a different value than what actually is (e.g. Shadows slider is showing Low but in reality its Epic)

notes.title: Frontier Season 3 Release
notes.content:
Almost two months have passed since the last Frontier update, but the wait is over and a new season has been released. New weapons, new mechanics, a brand new map, and much more has been added to the latest build of Frontier. Here is everything that has been added & updated:



MAP:
 - New map: Polara
 - New POIs: Hanamura, Shipment Bay, Sakura, Lindenburg, The Manor, Ferncroft, Southern Town
 - Returning POIs: Barnhouses (Farm), Kali-Jun (extended), City (extended with Outpost), Industry, Shipyard

SKINS:
 - New skins: Mask, James, Doctor, Nurak, Crypto

GAME:
 - Added proper Loading Screens
 - Implemented surface memory level anti-cheat (SCUE5)

GAMEPLAY:
 - Revamped the whole inventory system. You can now carry up to 4 items and use keybinds num 1-4 to switch instead of scroll wheel
 - Removed the ability to swim and go prone
 - Nerfed fall damage; max possible fall damage is now 40
 - Nerfed bots accuracy by 33% for hitscan weapons
 - Changed pickup Ultra weapons color from purple to orange
 - Fixed directional damage reticle widget not working on client
 - Increased Endgame Zone radius by 55%
 - Removed Sandbox game mode
 - Removed the ability to gain XP while in training mode
 - Greatly updated the InGame UI

WEAPONS/ITEMS: 

 - Added new weapons/items: Guardian DMR, Marksman Rifle, Armor Pistol, SixShot Revolver, Burst AR, 
    TwinAuto Shotgun
 - The following weapons are now projectile-based (they have bullet travel time and drop-off)
    - Eagle-Eye Sniper Rifle
    - Deadeye DMR
    - Guardian DMR
    - Ambush AR
 - Buffed the Burst SMG's damage by 2 in each rarity and increased the fire rate from 0.185 (burst 
    interval) to 0.135
 - Buffed Eagle-Eye damage by 22% for each rarity
 - Buffed Deadeye DMR's damage by 22% for each rarity
 - Nerfed Sawed-Off Shotgun's clip size from 4 to 2
 - You dont have to be looking at a wall or floor to launch with the Sawed-Off; instead, it launches you 
    up whenever, even when in air

VERSION 3.0.0
Frontier: Battle Royale Deyn V 2025

notes.title: v1.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
I have rolled out an important patch for Frontier:

 
 - Fixed bots not moving to safe zone when inside the zone
 - Altered the look of the following UI's: SpectatorWidget, PostMatchWidget.
 - Decreased movement speed when walking, aiming, crouching, and sprinting from 600, 300, 350, and 
    775 respectfully to 550, 250, 300, and 750. This change is to balance the overall movement speed as 
    to me it felt like the character was a bit too fast. Note that the sliding speed has not been changed 
    (still at 800-1000, depening if you are sliding down a slope)
 - Added a FireRate timer between shotguns, thus disabling the ability to double-pump
 - Pump Shotgun now has 5 in the clip with a shotgun reload as opposed to the 1 in the clip with a short 
    reload. A gunplay montage is still being played in between shooting the Pump Shotgun
 - Bots now drop a med kit occasionally every 10-30 seconds or so, to heal them up and make fighting 
    them more challenging as they have more health
 - Bots weapon spread has been increased and randomized, to prevent pin-point accuracy from them in 
    some cases (was X: -1.5 to 1.5 Y: -0.5 to 0.5 / now X: -2.0 to 2.0 Y: -1.0 to 1.0)
 - Weapon attachments are now random if you select the "Random" (formerly "Empty") attachment, and 
    it will be randomized every single time you equip and switch a weapon
 - Adjusted the spectator camera to be 60 units more vertical to enhance spectator visibility
